game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar, an altar half-sunk in earth: the scholar mage must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Merge Convoy: Merge two lists using + or extend() to join convoys.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Sunken Altar: an altar half-sunk in earth
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Integer division: declare resource as int, apply resource / 2, and print each result with %d. Dataset 8 starts with [-3, 0, 20, 23]. Match every stream. Use a full main function and a return statement.
controls: Edit the C program. Run tests all streams; Step shows declarations, assignments and output. readInput() is a LogiCade game-port helper declared in logicade.h. This safe practice runtime supports a documented C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Merge Convoy' (Week 7 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Sunken Altar'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Basic Parts of C and Variable Declarations

region.name: Eldritch Ruins

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.

Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Protect the moon altar from rune wisps in Sunken Altar: keep the convoy_size meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: convoy_size drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
hint: Declare before use. int resource = readInput(); creates the named game-port value; printf uses %d.
